page_title: Powerdrill Bloom - Your AI Workspace with Memory

summary.name: Powerdrill Bloom
summary.one_liner: Powerdrill Bloom is an AI workspace that lets you ask questions across your documents and databases in plain language, with answers traced back to their source page, row and figure.
use_cases: querying company documents in plain language
analyzing data from databases without writing SQL
running recurring analyses on a schedule
getting numbers traced to source pages and rows
analyzing sensitive data inside a private network
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI workspace that answers questions across documents and databases in plain language. Each number in an answer is said to come back with the page, row and figure it came from. Agents are described as learning from each analysis, which the page presents as memory. A "Scheduled Agent" feature runs recurring analyses automatically. The product can run on-premise or in a private cloud for data that must stay inside a network.
notable: Answers cite the page, row and figure behind each number
Scheduled Agent runs recurring analysis automatically
On-premise or private cloud deployment for sensitive data
Agents retain memory and learn from prior analyses
caveats: Page only mentions a free trial ("Try For Free") and a time-limited sale; no pricing tiers are listed, so the free/paid split is unclear
Marketing-heavy page with few technical details on supported data sources or file formats
